$comment: Source register. Every row states what was checked, where it was checked, and how far the verification actually got. Three tiers are used and never conflated: 'verbatim' (official page fetched in this session and quoted exactly), 'excerpt' (official-domain text returned by the search index, full page not fetched in this session), 'unresolved' (conflicting or absent - no value adopted).

sources.title: Associates Program Operating Agreement (US)

verified_claims.claim: Associate links must use Amazon's special 'tagged' link formats ('Special Links').
verified_claims.quote: The links must properly use the special “tagged” link formats we provide and comply with this Agreement (“Special Links”).

verified_claims.claim: The disclosure sentence is fixed and must be clear and prominent on the Site.
verified_claims.quote: You must clearly and prominently state the following, or any substantially similar statement previously allowed under this Agreement, on your Site or any other location where Amazon may authorize your display or other use of Program Content: “As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.”

verified_claims.claim: We may not imply Amazon supports, sponsors or endorses us or our Site.
verified_claims.quote: You will not misrepresent or embellish our relationship with you (including by expressing or implying that we support, sponsor, or endorse you) ...

verified_claims.claim: Violating Section 5 or the Program Policies is a material breach.
verified_claims.quote: For the avoidance of doubt and without limitation for purposes of the foregoing subsection (a) any violation of Section 5 and as specified in the Program Policies will be deemed a material breach of this Agreement.

verified_claims.claim: Amazon makes no representation about traffic or commission income an Associate can expect.
verified_claims.quote: We do not make any representation, warranty, or covenant regarding the amount of traffic or commission income you can expect at any time in connection with the Associates Program, and we will not be liable for any actions you undertake based on your expectations.

sources.verification_method: fetched in-session with the page fetcher; chunks 0 and 1 of 4 read; quotes copied from the fetched text
sources.notes: Cited throughout the site as the contractual basis for the disclosure strip, the sponsored marking, and the no-price rule.

sources.title: Associates Program Policies

verified_claims.claim: A site may display price and availability only when the data comes from an Amazon-served link or the Creators/PA API, and cached data must be refreshed within 24 hours.
verified_claims.why_unresolved: This page was not fetched in-session (the URL routes through a JavaScript console shell). The rule is described consistently by two independent secondary write-ups, but this project does not treat a secondary description as a verified contract term.
verified_claims.effect_on_this_project: Precautionary and strict: no price, availability, star rating or review count is published anywhere on the site, and the build fails if a currency pattern reaches the output. Being wrong about the rule therefore cannot cause a violation.

sources.verification_method: URL and section name confirmed from the nav links present in the fetched S01 page; policy body not fetched
sources.owner_action: Open this page while logged into Associates Central and confirm the price/caching wording before any price is ever displayed. Blocks SG-14.

sources.title: FTC's Endorsement Guides: What People Are Asking (affiliate marketing section)

verified_claims.claim: Affiliate marketers must disclose the relationship clearly and conspicuously on the site.
verified_claims.quote: You should disclose your relationship to the retailer clearly and conspicuously on your site, so readers can decide how much weight to give your endorsement. You could say something like, “I get commissions for purchases made through links in this post.”

verified_claims.claim: A material connection that a significant minority of consumers would not expect must be disclosed.
verified_claims.quote: if there's a connection between an endorser and the marketer that a significant minority of consumers wouldn't expect and it would affect how they evaluate the endorsement, that connection should be disclosed clearly and conspicuously

sources.verification_method: official-domain text returned by the search index on 2026-11-20; full page not fetched in-session
sources.notes: Regulatory basis for putting the disclosure in a visible strip rather than only on a separate page, and for repeating it in the footer.

sources.title: FTC staff sample educational letter to influencers (clear and conspicuous standard)

verified_claims.claim: Placement matters: disclose above any 'more' cutoff, do not bury the disclosure in a string of tags, use unambiguous language.
verified_claims.quote: To make a disclosure both “clear” and “conspicuous,” you should use unambiguous language and make the disclosure stand out. Consumers should be able to notice the disclosure easily, and not have to look for it.

verified_claims.claim: A button or hyperlink to a disclosure page is not, by itself, a sufficient disclosure.
verified_claims.quote: Would a button on a web page that says DISCLOSURE or LEGAL or something like that be enough, so long as the button links to a full disclosure? No. A hyperlinked disclosure like that is easily avoidable, meaning that the disclosure is not clear and conspicuous.

sources.verification_method: official-domain text returned by the search index on 2026-11-20
sources.notes: This is why the site's disclosure is inline text on every page and the /disclosure/ page is a supplement, never a replacement.

verified_claims.claim: All poultry to 165 F as measured with a food thermometer.
verified_claims.quote: Poultry: Cook all poultry to an internal temperature of 165 °F as measured with a food thermometer.

verified_claims.claim: Raw ground beef, pork, lamb and veal to 160 F.
verified_claims.quote: Ground meats: Cook all raw ground beef, pork, lamb, and veal to an internal temperature of 160 °F as measured with a food thermometer.

verified_claims.claim: Whole cuts of beef, pork, lamb, veal to 145 F with a 3-minute rest.
verified_claims.quote: Cook all raw beef, pork, lamb and veal steaks, chops, and roasts to a minimum internal temperature of 145 °F as measured with a food thermometer before removing meat from the heat source. For safety and quality, allow meat to rest for at least three minutes before carving or consuming.

sources.title: Product Advertising API 5.0 / Creators API access eligibility

verified_claims.claim: Catalog API access is gated on recent qualifying sales; the exact threshold is disputed.
verified_claims.effect_on_this_project: No sales threshold, eligibility date, or 'you qualify because' statement is published anywhere on the site. The pipeline is built to refuse catalog data until credentials exist (see the research_snapshot schema), so the dispute changes nothing that a reader sees.

conflict.position_a: 3 qualifying sales in the past 30 days (older, widely repeated account of PA-API 5.0 rules)
conflict.position_b: 10 qualifying sales in the trailing 30 days (reported from Associates Central documentation as of late 2025; also reported per-locale)
conflict.position_c: official API usage text historically read 'loses access ... if it has not generated qualified referring sales for a consecutive 30-day period'

verified_claims.resolution: Not resolved in this session. No sales figure, threshold, or eligibility date is published on the site. The site states only that API credentials are required and are not held.

verified_claims.claim: PA-API 5.0 is reported to be superseded by the Creators API (OAuth-based, re-registration required).
verified_claims.why_unresolved: Secondhand; the official deprecation notice was not fetched. Recorded as an open question (Q-12), not as a fact.
